page.overview:
Who is Parker?

Commander Parker was a member of Starfleet in the 2370s.

He was the second-in-command of the unit that was assigned to protect the Dominion communication array on AR-558 after the Federation Alliance captured the Chin'toka system in late 2374. He was later killed, and command of the depleted unit passed to Lieutenant Nadia Larkin. ()
